根喝到的水怎样到叶子里？: How does water reach the leaves?
一起跟着蓝色水滴，从土里出发，走过根和茎，最后来到叶子。: Follow the blue water markers from soil through roots and stem, all the way to a leaf.
蓝色标记帮助我们看见路线。真的水汽通常看不见。: Blue markers reveal the route. Real water vapor is usually invisible.
根从土里吸收水。根没有嘴巴，水能穿过根的表面进入植物。: Roots take up water from soil. They have no mouths: water enters through the root surface.
水沿着茎里的细小通道向上走。这些运水的组织叫木质部。: Water moves up tiny channels in the stem. This water-carrying tissue is called xylem.
水沿着叶脉到达叶子。植物也用水制造养分、保持身体挺立。: Water reaches leaves through their veins. Plants also use water to make food and stay firm.
一部分水在叶里变成水汽，通过气孔离开。这叫蒸腾，也帮助拉动下面的水。: Some water becomes vapor inside a leaf and leaves through pores. This is transpiration, which helps pull water up from below.
水沿水势梯度从土壤进入根，经木质部运输。叶内蒸发产生的张力和水分子的内聚性共同维: Water enters roots down a water-potential gradient and travels through xylem. Evaporation in leaves creates tension; cohesion helps maintain a connected column of water. Stomata regulate gas exchange and water loss. Water also supports photosynthesis and cell turgor; not all absorbed water becomes plant tissue.
蓝点是路线标记，不是能看见的真实水分子。画面把木质部、气孔和运输阶段放大分开；真: Blue dots mark a route rather than visible water molecules. Xylem, stomata and stages are enlarged and separated; actual transport is continuous. A cut-celery experiment shows stem transport from a cut surface, not root uptake by itself.
土里的水进入根，沿着茎中的通道到叶子。一部分又变成水汽，进入空气。: Water enters roots from soil, travels through channels in the stem and reaches leaves. Some becomes water vapor and enters the air.
给芹菜看“彩色路线”: Find a colored route in celery
请大人把切好的芹菜茎放进加了食用色素的水里。等一等，看看叶脉哪里变了色。: Ask a grown-up to place a cut celery stalk in water with food coloring. Wait and observe which leaf veins change color.
